title: Prospective AT2 energy consistency evaluation and supervisor decision evidence
finding: Prospective evaluation of Hypothesis H8 (mesh-aware AT2 energy consistency): independent holdouts on Package 119 (Increment 85, |r_E| = 0.209% <= 0.250%) and Package 123 (Increment 86, |r_E| = 0.235% <= 0.250%) confirm that the regularized AT2 functional mathematically explains an energy offset of +1.92% to +2.16% upon C3 -> C4 refinement without free parameter fitting, but applicability is strictly bounded to the pre-peak stationary regime (d_max <= 0.65). Verified deliverables on disk: evaluation script (SHA256 428F04D5...), evidence artifact (SHA256 8903436E...), unit test suite with 6/6 tests passed (SHA256 85F94B30...), and supervisor decision memorandum (SHA256 9DAEE8F0...). In accordance with thesis governance, this prospective criterion provides evidentiary justification for future supervisory threshold revision but does NOT retroactively alter the failed Level 3 gate for Package 113 (+2.00803158% > 2.00000000%). Reconciled zero active cluster jobs and strictly retained binding gate STAGE_C1_2_STEP2_ENERGY_GATE_FAILED (C5 advancement prohibited).
